name: tollgate
description: Tollgate — AI Control Layer: an OpenAI-compatible proxy that enforces a hot-reloaded policy.yaml with deterministic + local-model semantic controls, budgets, a historical-attack signature feed, a hash-chained audit log, a dashboard and a self-testing suite. HackYeah 2026, Goldman Sachs partner task.

scripts._comment_dev: bun's native --filter runs each app's `dev` script concurrently with prefixed output; no `concurrently` dependency needed. apps/gateway defines dev = `bun --watch src/server.ts`, apps/dashboard defines dev = `next dev -p 3000` (runs under Node, never `bun --bun`).
scripts._comment_test: bun test from the repo root picks up bunfig.toml and tests/**/*.test.ts. Deterministic cases always run; fixtures with tags: [model] skip with a message when Ollama/models are absent. test:fast selects cases whose name carries the [deterministic] tag (SPEC §11.2).
scripts._comment_tools: Entry points below are TODO until the milestone that creates them (SPEC §1.4, §11.2). Keep the script names and paths.
scripts._comment_check: `check` is the gate for every milestone commit: typecheck every workspace + validate policy.yaml.
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run policy:check
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tests && tsc --noEmit -p examples

_comment_deps: Root holds toolchain deps plus yaml and zod for the test harness and openai for examples/openai-sdk.ts; runtime deps live in each workspace (apps/gateway: hono, yaml, zod; apps/dashboard: next, react, react-dom; packages/policy: zod, yaml).
